node.title: Re^8: Nodelet style broken?
node.author: jdporter
node.doctext:
I believe this was a bug which is now fixed. I had committed a small change which set the user's nodelets_as_div setting to 1 whenever visiting the /mobile/ version of the site. I didn't think that change would get persisted into the database, but apparently it does, at least for AM; so I have local'ized that setting.

Sorry :-(

I reckon we are the only monastery ever to have a dungeon stuffed with 16[523120|,]000 zombies.
